authority.sourceOfTruth: EQP qualification record and evidence obligations
authority.promotionBoundary: EQP qualifies claims; FPB or ACP separately authorizes promotion

unsupported: qualification does not authorize deployment, publication, spending, or promotion

compatibility.behavior: fail closed on missing required evidence
compatibility.authority: evaluator and qualification authority remain explicit
compatibility.evidence: contradictory and out-of-scope evidence remain visible

checks: every evidence item is consumed, rejected, contradictory, or out-of-scope

migration.adopt: import existing evidence without changing its qualification status
migration.repin: re-qualify when dependency, context, evaluator, or assumptions change
migration.deviation: record any local qualification rule as a deviation
